reason_for_pre_outcome_revision: v1 applied the environmental coverage requirement to all raw GPS observations. The original preregistration instead defines a fixed 24 h target grid first and forms pairs only when the preselected endpoints pass phase reconstruction. v2 restores that ordering before any environmental extraction or lambda outcome is opened.

target_selection.selection_input: raw GPS with frozen MODIS cell identity
target_selection.nearest_observation_rule: nearest raw GPS within non-overlapping +/-3 h target window
target_selection.tie_break_rule: minimum absolute target-time deviation; if tied, earlier observed timestamp; if still tied, lexicographically smaller observation_id

environmental_phase.invalid_environmental_target_rule: mark the already selected target invalid; do not substitute another GPS observation

pairing.rule: form a phase pair only for adjacent target indices when both preselected targets have valid environmental phase

claim_boundary: This v2 revision changes only the pre-outcome ordering of GPS target selection and environmental validity so that environmental missingness cannot alter which GPS observation represents a registered 24 h target.
